newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore CPI rises 1.7 pct in June year-on-year.
newsitem.headline: Singapore CPI rises 1.7 pct in June year-on-year.

text.p: Singapore's consumer price index (CPI) of inflation was up 1.7 percent in June from the same month last year and up 0.2 percent over May 1997, the Department of Statistics said on Wednesday.
A Reuters poll of 12 economists last week forecast the CPI would rise 1.8 percent in June from a year earlier.
In May, the CPI rose 1.6 percent from a year ago and 0.2 percent from April.

Note - In June, year-on-year food costs rose 1.9 percent, clothing fell 2.4 percent, housing rose 1.4 percent, transport and communications rose 5.1 percent, education and stationery rose 1.6 percent, health rose 3.6 percent and miscellaneous costs fell 0.3 percent.
